1. `getUsers()` to fetch all 10 users and their IDs/names.
2. `df.lib.per_entity` fans out `getPostsByUser` over every user ID in one substrate step.
3. Maps each result to `{name, postCount}`, then sorts by `postCount` descending with name ascending as the tiebreaker.
